topic: Adversarially find what the planned Pi Remote packet MISSES. Read the nine phase specs under specs/cli-external-orchestration/041-pi-remote-mobile-agent-like-cc/ (001 contract+threat baseline and its ADR-002 stack decision, 002 test harness, 003 relay-protocol-and-state incl. the versioned typed event envelope + sync.delta/snapshot/gap, 004 auth-and-tailnet-boundary incl. QR device enrollment + authenticated Serve identity, 005 mobile-pwa-and-reconciliation incl. the Vite/React 19/Untitled UI stack + four-surface IA Home/Session/Review/Attention-Inbox + typed-block transcript, 006 approval-and-remote-mutation incl. typed approval.requested/decide/result events + bounded accept-edits grants, 007 push-and-platform-hardening incl. the bounded needs_input/finished/error attention class + Attention Inbox, 008 documentation, 009 release). The product is a private installable PWA remote-controlling the Pi coding agent over a Tailscale tailnet, aiming to match and exceed the Claude Code + mobile pairing without weakening a loopback-relay/tailnet-only/foreground-authority/redaction posture. For EACH phase identify: (a) missing or absent requirements, (b) underspecified mechanisms (named but not defined — e.g. the containment primitive, the Serve identity signal, the SQLite/migration choice, the diff-truth model, reconnection reconciliation corner cases), (c) internal contradictions or cross-phase inconsistencies, (d) untestable or unfalsifiable acceptance criteria (no thresholds, no objective check), (e) unhandled edge cases and failure modes (crash points, races/TOCTOU, offline/stale, multi-device, revocation, key rotation, push platform limits especially iOS), and (f) security or privacy holes. Rank the gaps by severity, map each to its phase, and propose a concrete remediation (a REQ or ADR to add). Prefer gaps grounded in the actual spec text; cite the phase and requirement you are critiquing.
